purpose.text: Finish a local Next.js company website for AeolusLabs, aimed at small and growing African businesses (Nigeria first), then launch it on aeoluslabsltd.com.

tasks.title: Fix the security lock: upgrade Next.js
tasks.purpose: Next.js 16.4.0 had critical remote-code-execution flaws; patched in 16.4.1+.

approval.basis: User said 'lets fix the lock' in chat on 2026-11-04 after the security finding was explained

acceptance_criteria.check: package.json pins a Next.js version >= 16.4.1
pnpm typecheck and pnpm build both exit 0
pnpm audit shows zero advisories for the next package
Built site's routes respond and the enquiry API still validates

tasks.title: Choose ONE style for the whole site
tasks.purpose: Homepage (navy/lime) and inner pages (older layout) do not match; minimalist prototypes are unapproved.

acceptance_criteria.check: Owner states which style wins (recorded in design-explorations.md and DESIGN.md)

tasks.title: Make the contact form really send email, with spam limits
tasks.purpose: Today the form only prepares a mailto draft; no rate limiting.

acceptance_criteria.check: Resend key and verified sender configured (secrets kept out of the repo)
A real test enquiry arrives at info@aeoluslabsltd.com
Repeated rapid submissions from one source are limited

tasks.title: Collect missing content from the owner
tasks.purpose: Real assets are needed; nothing may be invented.

acceptance_criteria.check: Real Vib3Pulse screenshots supplied and added
Founder portraits and short bios supplied and added
Social-sharing (OG) image added
Final logo supplied or current recreation confirmed
Written client permission recorded before any other client is published

tasks.title: Check Vib3Pulse feature claims
tasks.purpose: Account-only features (QR tickets, wallet, Safety Buddy, SOS) are unverified.

acceptance_criteria.check: Each listed feature is confirmed in the product or removed/softened on the site

tasks.title: Apply the chosen style to all pages
tasks.purpose: One consistent look across Home, Work, Solutions, Products, About, Contact, Privacy.

acceptance_criteria.check: Every route uses the chosen style
No horizontal overflow at 390/768/1440 widths
Keyboard navigation and visible focus work on every page

tasks.title: Fix page titles, theme colour and canonical address
tasks.purpose: Metadata still says 'Real problems. Thoughtful solutions', theme colours are white/black, and the live domain redirects to www.

acceptance_criteria.check: Titles and descriptions match the approved homepage message
Theme colour matches the site
Owner picks www or bare domain; metadataBase and sitemap match it

tasks.title: Tidy leftovers
tasks.purpose: Unused code and files, plus an unfixed text-encoding glitch.

acceptance_criteria.check: Unused components and public placeholder files removed
CLIENT-CASE-STUDIES-DRAFT.md saved as valid UTF-8
next-env.d.ts dev-only change not committed
Typecheck and build still pass after cleanup

tasks.title: Test it properly
tasks.purpose: No device, speed or accessibility testing has been recorded on the final site.

acceptance_criteria.check: Lighthouse run recorded for Home and one inner page
Checked on a real phone and a laptop
End-to-end enquiry test passes
Screen-reader/keyboard spot check recorded

tasks.title: Merge and go live
tasks.purpose: main still has the old homepage; domain currently shows an older site.

acceptance_criteria.check: Branch reviewed and merged to main
Vercel project and environment variables set
aeoluslabsltd.com serves the new site
Post-launch check of every page and the form

tasks.title: Optional: patch build-tool advisories
tasks.purpose: nanoid, browserslist and source-map-js advisories remain in build tooling (not served to visitors).

acceptance_criteria.check: pnpm overrides or updates applied, or risk accepted in writing

tasks.title: Fix empty grey tile on Solutions page
tasks.purpose: Seven services in a two-column grid leave one blank cell that shows as a grey block (seen in 2026-11-04 screenshot; cause: .feature-grid background shows through).

acceptance_criteria.check: No blank grey cell at 390, 768 and 1440 widths, whatever the service count

milestones.title: Safe and working
milestones.outcome: No known security holes in the site itself, and the contact form really delivers enquiries.

milestones.title: One look, real content
milestones.outcome: One agreed design on every page, with real screenshots, founder details and metadata.

milestones.title: Tested and live
milestones.outcome: Checked on real devices, merged to main and live on the owned domain.

latest_handoff.summary: Upgraded Next.js 16.4.0 to 16.4.5 (T-001 verified: typecheck, build, audit, smoke test). Created architecture/ checklist with 12 tasks. Visually compared homepage, minimalist prototype and Solutions page; recommended keeping the navy direction, calmed down.
latest_handoff.next: Owner decides T-002 (whole-site style) and T-007 (www vs bare domain); then set up email and rate limiting (T-003).
latest_handoff.notes: Changes are uncommitted. Remaining non-shadcn advisories are build tooling only (T-011). Local console error about /_vercel/insights is expected outside Vercel.
